# crosswork_aaa_password_policy (Resource)

This resource can manage the AAA local password policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_aaa_password_policy" "example" {
  min_password_length                  = 9
  no_username                          = true
  no_cisco_variant                     = true
  no_char_repetition                   = true
  num_changed_chars_enabled            = true
  num_changed_chars                    = 2
  num_reuse_limit_enabled              = true
  num_reuse_limit                      = 6
  password_reuse_days_enabled          = true
  password_reuse_days                  = 16
  failed_logins_before_lockout_enabled = true
  failed_logins_before_lockout         = 6
  lock_out_user_time_enabled           = true
  lock_out_user_time                   = 7
  password_expiry_days_enabled         = true
  password_expiry_days                 = 61
  days_for_warning_enabled             = true
  days_for_warning                     = 16
  change_password_on_first_login       = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `change_password_on_first_login` (Boolean) Require a new password at the first login
  - Default value: `true`
- `days_for_warning` (Number) Days before the expiry that a warning is shown
  - Default value: `15`
- `days_for_warning_enabled` (Boolean) Warn users before their password expires
  - Default value: `true`
- `failed_logins_before_lockout` (Number) Number of failed login attempts before the lockout
  - Default value: `5`
- `failed_logins_before_lockout_enabled` (Boolean) Lock a user out after failed login attempts
  - Default value: `true`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `lock_out_user_time` (Number) Minutes a user stays locked out
  - Default value: `6`
- `lock_out_user_time_enabled` (Boolean) Lock a user out for a time
  - Default value: `true`
- `min_password_length` (Number) Minimum number of characters of a password
  - Default value: `8`
- `no_char_repetition` (Boolean) Reject a password that repeats a character more than three times in a row
  - Default value: `true`
- `no_cisco_variant` (Boolean) Reject a password that contains `cisco`, `ocsic` or a capitalized variant of them
  - Default value: `true`
- `no_username` (Boolean) Reject a password that contains the user name or its reverse
  - Default value: `true`
- `num_changed_chars` (Number) Number of characters a new password must change
  - Default value: `1`
- `num_changed_chars_enabled` (Boolean) Require a number of changed characters in a new password
  - Default value: `true`
- `num_reuse_limit` (Number) Number of last passwords that cannot be reused
  - Default value: `5`
- `num_reuse_limit_enabled` (Boolean) Limit the reuse of the last passwords
  - Default value: `true`
- `password_expiry_days` (Number) Days after which a password expires
  - Default value: `60`
- `password_expiry_days_enabled` (Boolean) Expire passwords after a number of days
  - Default value: `true`
- `password_reuse_days` (Number) Number of days a used password cannot be reused
  - Default value: `15`
- `password_reuse_days_enabled` (Boolean) Limit the reuse of passwords used in the last days
  - Default value: `true`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_aaa_password_policy.example "aaa_password_policy"
```
